set.body:
Outcome: a reproducible, human-reviewable comparison of original fsLR 32k inflated and veryinflated that determines whether either is a suitable group-display baseline before smoothing is considered. Owner: ScalaFIM surface-view QA. P1 visual qualification.

Shared discovery tags: standard-surface-qa, fslr-32k. Canonical plan: docs/plans/fslr32k-standard-surface-qualification.md. This ticket also owns that planning document; writing the plan does not complete the court.

Acceptance:
1. Preserve earlier subject-based artifacts and visibly supersede their use as quality/default evidence. They used a previously rejected warped inflated fixture. Keep original unwarped ds000001 sub-01 only as a named regression fixture; retain warped inputs only as labeled negative controls. Add provenance/hash guards against accidental baseline reuse.
2. Use the admitted bilateral TemplateFlow fsLR 32k family, exact source bytes, unfiltered geometry-derived normals and no coordinate smoothing. Produce the 24-cell geometry matrix: 2 display forms x 2 hemispheres x lateral/medial x 3 recorded light directions. Fix material, projection, shared union framing, light vectors, scale, background and render settings within each matched comparison. Show an optional separately labeled fit-to-pane usability plate.
3. Add matched synthetic scalar controls, generated once on the common vertex axis/anatomical coordinates and reused exactly across displays: asymmetric landmarks, smooth signed gradient, localized high-contrast patches, valid zero and missingness. Use a fixed declared transfer function, with unlit controls for color fidelity. Mask medial wall under the recorded boundary policy; record pick behavior. Do not borrow participant sulc/curvature or mislabel vertex-area shape data as curvature.
4. Render source-bound 1x and actual 2x PNGs, targeted posterior/frontal closeups, receipt JSON, input hashes and reproduction command. Inspect deterministic raster first, then the same scene on the claimed native backend before consumer default adoption. Include an independent viewer rendering of the same original assets where feasible to distinguish source shape from renderer defects. No exact cross-renderer pixel identity is assumed.
5. Judge posterior roughness, unintended pits/seams, recognizable landmarks, silhouette, scalar legibility, left/right consistency, medial-wall boundary and pick identity. Retain failures and user verdict. Roughness or pixel-difference metrics are diagnostics, not anatomical validity or aesthetic acceptance. Record time/memory on a declared machine without calling 32k performance qualified in advance.
6. Deliver a decision: inflated, veryinflated, or neither, with reasons. If roughness remains, separate input shape, normals/lighting and backend behavior before any bounded smoothing follow-up. Existing smoothing issue bd-01M34K30H3PZ1PDZRHZH7HK7YG stays optional; a mesh4s bug ticket requires a minimal public-API reproduction.

Prerequisite: local family-admission ticket, linked by a real Mote dependency. No dependency on volume projection or smoothing. Scope: examples/surface-view QA probe/tests and docs/verification, plus this plan. Real beta/FIR and PLSNeuro defaults are later consumer acceptance. Shared changed behavior requires JVM+JS; native claims require actual native evidence. No implementation, render or human acceptance is claimed by planning.
set.title: Compare fsLR 32k inflated and veryinflated with reproducible visual QA
